content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 indicates this service is bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable; the case provides no billing error or evidence supporting separate reimbursement. Authorization is not required, and neither an authorization request nor a medical-necessity review addresses the bundling determination. The contractual denial cannot be transferred to the patient merely because a deductible remains, so the appropriate next action is to write off the balance.","action":"write_off"}
